messages:
Alyssa: Kicking off the Kairos onboarding handoff. Good morning team — we have a 6-week launch window and need to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a mitigation plan for renewal risk. Quick goals: 1) basic integration + test prompts by EOW-2, 2) pilot traffic 10k req/day by week 4, 3) baseline ROI signal for renewal discussion.
Juan: Thanks — I already introduced Alyssa to their lead PM (Lena) and Eng manager (Sam). They want product parity with existing vendor before pilot.
Mohit: Can we get the integration checklist? I want to scope SE time. Also need to know if they'll host in Dedicated or Redwood Private.
Alyssa: Good Q. Lena prefers Dedicated to start. I'll confirm tomorrow. SE checklist draft below: 
```
- API keys exchanged
- Sample dataset & prompt bank uploaded to S3
- Network allowlist completed
- Canary test harness setup
- Monitoring hooks (ops + perf)
```
Priya: For success criteria let's add qualitative accuracy metrics: >=85% NPS on core flows from early testers, and token cost per query < $0.02 for pilot workload.
onboard-bot: Reminder: kickoff doc created at https://redwood.atlassian.com/Kairos-Onboard (workspace restricted).
Juan: Timeline proposal: Week 0=kickoff & infra, Week 1=ingest prompts/data, Week 2=integration tests, Week 3=canary + initial QA, Week 4=pipeline scale to pilot. If Dedicated is used we need capacity request by Day 3.
Alyssa: Action items I have: confirm Dedicated, send SOW to Legal, schedule stakeholder weekly sync (30m). Who owns the canary scripts? @Mohit?
Mohit: I can own canary scripts and basic tracing. I'll need a sample of their longest prompt sequences + expected throughput.
Priya: I'll own success metric collection + initial eval set. Can we add a small survey to the pilot flows to capture customer feedback? 2 quick questions post-interaction.
Juan: I'll take capacity request and billing baseline with finance. Also will set up a security call with their SecOps — pinging Sam to join.
Alyssa: Nice. Risks: renewal pressure if parity not hit by week 6, integration blockers if allowlist delays. Mitigations: fallback to hosted small-size model for critical flows + weekly escalation channel.
Priya: Suggest weekly milestone emails to the customer with outcomes and regression screenshots — keeps them engaged and reduces churn risk.
Alyssa: Great. Next steps: 1) I confirm Dedicated by tomorrow, 2) Mohit posts canary template by EOD Thu, 3) Juan files capacity request by Day 3, 4) Priya shares eval checklist by Mon. I'll schedule weekly 30m sync first thing Mon. Any blockers?
Juan: No blockers from AE side. Sam said SecOps availability looks like Fri morning.
Mohit: No blockers. I'll need a sample dataset link — Alyssa, can you request from Lena?
Alyssa: Will do. Lena, can you drop a sample dataset and the first 20 test prompts in the Jira ticket this afternoon? :pray:
Lena (Kairos): Sure — will upload by 4pm. Excited to get started! :rocket:
onboard-bot: Task created: "Kairos canary + dataset" assigned to Mohit, due in 3 days.
Alyssa: Thanks team. I'll post the meeting invite and the runbook link. If anyone has follow-ups, drop them here or DM. :calendar:
